intro: Finds files that can be regenerated. A scan only reads: nothing changes until you confirm.
unavailable: The scanner is not installed, so Cleaner can't work on this system.
estimateNote: An estimate: hard links, open files, compression and snapshots change what is really freed.
incomplete: This scan is incomplete: more may exist than is shown here.
incomplete.files: This scan is incomplete: it reached the limit of items it examines.
incomplete.depth: This scan is incomplete: some folders are too deep to examine.
notOffered: Not offered: {n} (links, mounts, unreadable, protected or unusual names).
emptyHint: This scan found no regenerable files.
rule.thumbnails: Image thumbnails. They are created again the next time a folder is shown.
confirm.detail: {size} will move to the Trash. Moving to the Trash does not free space yet: space is freed only when the Trash is emptied.
confirm.notReady: {n} selected items can't be moved and will be left alone.
warn.linksElsewhere: Some items have hard links elsewhere: their space stays in use.
noneReady: None of the selected items can be moved: they changed since the scan.
trashNote: The items are in the Trash and can be restored from Files. Space is freed only when the Trash is emptied.
error.protocol: The scanner sent something invalid, so its results were discarded.
error.sandbox: The scanner could not lock itself in, so it did not run.
confirm.delete: {n} regenerable files ({size}) will be deleted. This can't be undone.
rule.fontconfig: The font cache. It is rebuilt when fonts are next used.
rule.shader-cache: Compiled graphics shaders. They are compiled again when needed.
rule.shader-db: The database of compiled graphics shaders. It is rebuilt when needed.
rule.media-registry: The list of media plugins. It is rebuilt the next time media plays.
rule.temporary: Temporary files older than a week. Check them first: they go to the Trash.
rule.trash: Items in the Trash. Empty the Trash to free their space.
